title: `ResourceUID::get_path_id()` cause crashes due race conditions with `add_id`/`remove_id`
body:
### Tested versions

4.8.dev.custom_build. e7cfa294a

### System information

Ubuntu 26.04

### Issue description

Due missing Mutex.lock() in `ResourceUID::get_path_id()`, code crashes with such info
